meta.title: Approver Actions: refused for a user without the Approver role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Approver role and verify Approve, Reject, Comment, and Withdraw are refused or absent.
Repeat the same actions as an Approver and verify they are available and succeed.
Compare the two users' results in the same tenant and distinguish deliberate tenant RBAC configuration from a defect.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Approver role and verify Approve, Reject, Comment, and Withdraw are refused or absent.; Repeat the same actions as an Approver and verify they are available and succeed.; Compare the two users' results in the same tenant and distinguish deliberate tenant RBAC configuration from a defect.

steps.note: Open the closest catalog-supported screen containing approval-related actions before the manual role comparison.

args.need: sign in as a non-Approver and an Approver in the same tenant, try Approve, Reject, Comment, and Withdraw as each user, and record whether each action is absent, refused, or succeeds

steps.note: The catalog cannot change user roles or execute the requested authorization comparison.
Assert that the current screen remains free of crashes or server errors after the manual authorization checks.
